ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
ApiKeyAuth.description: Format of Authorization value should be `Token: xxxxxx`

get.description: Returns public Remo events that have opted into discovery, most recently created first. Results exclude private, archived, ended, and trial-company events. Ordered by creation time descending.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive prefix filter on the event name.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-100, default 9).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of events to skip for pagination (default 0).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction by creation time (default desc, newest first).

403.description: API key is not authorized for event discovery

get.summary: Attendance report for a host's events
get.description: Returns the attendees who actually joined the events created by the given host between the From and To dates (filtered by event start time). Each row reports the attendee's email, the event URL, their login and logout times (ISO-8601), and their role. Only attendees with a recorded session are included.

parameters.name: hostEmail
parameters.description: Email address of the host who created the events.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the event date range (inclusive), ISO-8601.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the event date range (inclusive), ISO-8601.

403.description: API key is not authorized for event attendance reporting
